description: This file contains the source code for the Api class within the Opencart\\Catalog\\Model\\Account namespace. It defines methods for user authentication (login), session management (addSession), and access control (getIps) related to the OpenCart API system.

classes.name: Api
classes.description: A model class responsible for API-related operations such as login and session management within the account namespace.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates a user based on username and key, returning user data if credentials are valid.

methods.name: addSession
methods.description: Creates a new API session record with session ID and IP address, returning the session ID of the inserted record.

methods.name: getIps
methods.description: Retrieves all IP addresses associated with a given API ID.
